title: Earliest recorded S27 Ultra leak timeline
scope: Donsetch searches for S27 Ultra reports before 28 July 2025; 22 June 2025 is the earliest dated readable result located in this review. This is a search finding, not proof that no earlier private or unindexed leak existed.

reports.title: The earliest located reports: a possible S Pen slot removal
reports.summary: The earliest dated S27 Ultra reports located in this review said Samsung might remove the built-in S Pen slot, potentially freeing space for a larger battery, slimmer hardware or other internal priorities. Gizmochina attributed the claim to Setsuna Digital; Sammy Fans and SamMobile described the same broader rumor through related tipster coverage.

reports.title: A month later: triple-camera design and Sony main sensor rumored
reports.summary: Notebookcheck reported an Ice Universe Weibo leak claiming the S27 Ultra could drop the 3× telephoto lens, use a larger 200-megapixel Sony main sensor, retain a 50-megapixel 5× periscope camera and move to three rear cameras. The article described this as an unconfirmed plan with time left to change.
